state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 2 (registration): the fixture extension has landed; the runner, the layer and the compile entry have not.** The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; this goal has no record slot.

The fixture `Shop\Ledger` is `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/ledger/` (`module.wat`, `api.wit`, `manifest.json`, `source/Ledger/Receipt.nvs.src`) packed into the committed `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/ledger.nvsx`. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs` holds every `<name>.nvsx` to what the packer builds from `<name>/`, loads the ledger, and round-trips each echo export through wasmtime directly; its module doc owns the layout and the `NVS_WRITE_FIXTURES=1` rewrite. The fixture is a core module the packer componentizes, not component text: `wit-component` writes the component types (decided in that module doc).

Two gaps in the fixture, both Stage 3's: the named rows of 0246 § 1 (enum, closed union, `Core` value class, `resource`) are absent because the loader refuses them until the manifest carries what they name (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:26`), and `kindOf` (`mixed`) is loaded but never called, since that needs the host's `value` resource.

next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs`, `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs`; then the checker, `crates/nvs-types/src/signatures.rs`, `crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs`, a new `crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs`, its own session if the first set fills one.

items.text: **A case loads a fixture** — a new `--EXTENSION--` section in `crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs:323`'s `KNOWN` lists fixture names, one per line; `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs:192`'s `run_case` copies `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/<name>.nvsx` into the case's directory and adds its `[[extension]]` entry with its pin to the case's `nvs.toml`, creating the file when the case wrote none. A name with no fixture is a parse error naming it. `rule:packaging/an-nvsx-is-one-file-carrying-its-manifest`.

**The layer** — a new `crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs`, shaped like `error_lib.rs`, seeded after `iter_lib::seed` at `crates/nvs-types/src/signatures.rs:742`: each manifest class a `ClassSignature` (`crates/nvs-types/src/signatures.rs:448`) whose `MethodSig`s carry each parameter's qualifier in `param_quals` as `crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs:135` does, and each `const` with its type; types from the manifest's Novis text, never the WIT. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

**The set reaches the compiler** — the compile entry the CLI and the runner share reads the resolved configuration's manifests (`nvs-ext` with `default-features = false`, no engine) and hands them to the checker; an extension class the set does not load is unknown. `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/args.rs:117` reads the registered signature with no extension branch. `rule:security/extension-manifest-only-tightens`.

backlog: The fixture's named rows and a `kindOf` call — Stage 3, `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs` and `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/ledger/`.
